scenario: LCST.4.1.6 — a `::` cast target must be a scalar builtin, `Json`, or a declared unit symbol; a SCHEMA name (or any unknown name) is never a cast target and rejects with DS_VALIDATE_CAST_UNDEFINED via the invalid-target branch (distinct from the closed-table LCST.4.5.3 undefined-pair rejects, e.g. unit_to_int_reject). Re-homes the [LCST.4.1.6] coverage the deleted, mis-namespaced LUNI.8.5_unit_assert_alias_unknown gestured at — but for the genuinely-invalid case (a schema target), since a unit ALIAS is a *valid* cast target (see LCST.4.5.2_cast_to_unit_alias_ok).
rules_ds:
schema Foo scope logical:
    v: Int key
schema Bar scope logical:
    b: Int key

rule bad:
    Foo f where f.v::Bar > 0
->
    log info "never"
